//! CodeGloss parser fixture. Stored as .rs.txt so that cargo does not try to
//! build it.

/// Looks the user up in the cache.
/// Falls back to the database on a miss.
pub fn find_user(id: u64) -> Option<String> {
    // The `//` in the URL below is not a comment. It sits inside a string
    // literal, and Tree-sitter leaves it there instead of guessing from the
    // raw text.
    let endpoint = "https://example.com/users"; // Trailing note.

    //////////

    // First paragraph of the second run.
    //
    // Second paragraph, split off by the empty comment above.

    /* A block comment
     * that continues on this line
     * and ends here.
     */
    let _ = (id, endpoint);
    None
}

/** Doc block attached to a struct. */
pub struct User;
